powershell:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop' $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$root = 'C:\LifeSciences' $appDir = "$root\SampleTracker" $installDir = "$root\Installers" $pythonDir = "$root\Python313"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $appDir,$installDir | Out-Null
# Restore embedded application package $encoded = '' $zip = "$appDir\lifesciences-app.zip" [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($zip,[Convert]::FromBase64String($encoded))
if ((Get-FileHash $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '82B5CE61023E69F23E473CD54F44D60BA486163A46C9A03324F2F41AB6AEA8DB') { throw 'Application ZIP checksum mismatch' }
Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $appDir -Force
# Download only verified software function Get-VerifiedInstaller($url,$path,$hash) { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $path -UseBasicParsing
if ((Get-FileHash $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $hash) { throw "Installer checksum failed: $path" }
if ((Get-AuthenticodeSignature $path).Status -ne 'Valid') { throw "Installer signature invalid: $path" } }
# Install IIS Install-WindowsFeature Web-Server -IncludeManagementTools | Out-Null Set-Service W3SVC -StartupType Automatic Start-Service W3SVC
Set-Content 'C:\inetpub\wwwroot\index.html' ` -Value '
Life Sciences - IIS is running'
# Install Python $pyInstaller = "$installDir\python.exe"
Get-VerifiedInstaller ` 'https://www.python.org/ftp/python/3.13.17/python-3.13.17-amd64.exe' ` $pyInstaller ` '5da012101ba2e17113a9a1cd901e9ce1441086f2b7ecb5de06ec94163899a190'
$arguments = @( '/quiet' 'InstallAllUsers=1' "TargetDir=$pythonDir" 'PrependPath=0' 'Include_pip=1' 'Include_launcher=0' 'Include_test=0' 'Include_tcltk=0' 'Include_doc=0' )
$p = Start-Process $pyInstaller -ArgumentList $arguments -Wait -PassThru if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Python installer failed: $($p.ExitCode)" }
# Create application environment and install dependencies $python = "$pythonDir\python.exe" & $python -m venv "$appDir\.venv" if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Virtual environment creation failed' }
$venvPython = "$appDir\.venv\Scripts\python.exe"
& $venvPython -m pip install --no-cache-dir ` -r "$appDir\requirements-deploy.txt"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Python package installation failed' }
# Download and install IIS URL Rewrite and ARR $rewrite = "$installDir\rewrite.msi" $arr = "$installDir\arr.msi"
Get-VerifiedInstaller ` 'https://download.microsoft.com/download/1/2/8/128E2E22-C1B9-44A4-BE2A-5859ED1D4592/rewrite_amd64_en-US.msi' ` $rewrite ` '37342FF2F585F263F34F48E9DE59EB1051D61015A8E967DBDE4075716230A32A'
Get-VerifiedInstaller ` 'https://download.microsoft.com/download/E/9/8/E9849D6A-020E-47E4-9FD0-A023E99B54EB/requestRouter_amd64.msi' ` $arr ` 'FB61FDB7101795A34D5129CB37EEE43AB675C7ED76BA3A3B23B039D8C90C2A4B'
foreach ($msi in @($rewrite,$arr)) { $p = Start-Process msiexec.exe ` -ArgumentList "/i `"$msi`" /qn /norestart" ` -Wait -PassThru
if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "IIS module installation failed: $($p.ExitCode)" } }
# Enable IIS reverse proxy $appcmd = "$env:windir\System32\inetsrv\appcmd.exe"
& $appcmd set config -section:system.webServer/proxy ` /enabled:true /commit:apphost
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'ARR proxy enablement failed' }
# Configure a localhost-only IIS test site Import-Module WebAdministration
$sitePath = 'C:\inetpub\LifeSciencesProxyTest' New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $sitePath | Out-Null
$webConfig = ''
Set-Content "$sitePath\web.config" -Value $webConfig -Encoding UTF8
New-Website -Name 'LifeSciences-Proxy-Test' ` -PhysicalPath $sitePath ` -IPAddress '127.0.0.1' -Port 8081 | Out-Null
# Configure IIS port 80 readiness endpoint $readinessWebConfig = @"
"@
Set-Content -Path 'C:\inetpub\wwwroot\web.config' ` -Value $readinessWebConfig -Encoding UTF8
# Start Flask automatically after Windows boots $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction ` -Execute $venvPython ` -Argument "`"$appDir\run_private_app.py`"" ` -WorkingDirectory $appDir
$trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtStartup
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal ` -UserId 'NT AUTHORITY\NETWORK SERVICE' ` -LogonType ServiceAccount ` -RunLevel Limited
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet ` -RestartCount 5 ` -RestartInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 1) ` -ExecutionTimeLimit ([TimeSpan]::Zero) ` -MultipleInstances IgnoreNew
Register-ScheduledTask ` -TaskName 'LifeSciences-Flask-Waitress' ` -Action $action -Trigger $trigger ` -Principal $principal -Settings $settings | Out-Null
Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'LifeSciences-Flask-Waitress'
# Verify application database readiness $ready = $false
for ($i=0; $i -lt 12; $i++) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
try { $result = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8081/ready' if ($result.status -eq 'ready') { $ready = $true break } } catch {} }
if (-not $ready) { throw 'Flask readiness check failed' }
Write-Output 'LIFESCIENCES_BOOTSTRAP_SUCCESS'
